'''Kōbe''' (こうべ, also read as こうど, ごうど, かんべ, かんど, じんこ, じんご, かのと)

== Overview ==
* [[Kōbe (Jinko)]] (かんべ/じんこ) - In [[:en:Ancient Japan|古代]] through the [[:en:Medieval period|中世]], a household associated with a specific [[Shinto shrine|神社]] to support its rituals and operations.
* [[Kōbe (asteroid)]] (こうべ) - An asteroid.
* Place names ([[#Locations and municipalities]]).
''' Kōbe (こうべ) - Appears on [[:en:Japanese license plates|日本のナンバープレート]] as a designation for the [[Kinki District Transport Bureau]]'s Kobe Transport Management Office in [[Higashinada Ward]], Kobe City, [[Hyōgo Prefecture]].
* People and other uses ([[#People and other uses]]).

== Locations and Municipalities ==
* [[Kōbe Domain]] (かんべはん) - A domain in the [[Suzuka District, Mie|Suzuka District]], [[Ise Province]]. Governed by the [[Q11590167]] and [[Honda clan|Honda Clan]].
''' [[Kōbe Castle]] (かんべじょう) - The main castle of the Kōbe Domain in Ise Province.
* [[:en:Kōbe|Kōbe]] (こうべ) - A place name in [[Hyōgo Prefecture]], originating from the area being the shrine estate (Kōbe) of [[Ikuta Shrine]].
''' [[:en:Kobe City|Kobe City]] - Located in Hyōgo Prefecture (こうべし).
''' [[:en:Kobe Port|Kobe Port]].
* [[Gōdo Town]] - Located in [[Anpachi District, Gifu|Ampachi District]], [[Gifu Prefecture]] (ごうどちょう).
''' For other Gōdo Towns (historical municipalities and neighborhoods), see [[Gōdo Town (disambiguation)|Gōdo Town (曖昧さ回避)]].
* [[Kobe Central Post Office]] - Located in [[Chūō-ku, Kobe]].
* [[Kobe Post Office]] - There are four in Japan (as of May 1, 2008), pronounced as follows: "Kanbe" (千葉県館山市, 愛知県田原市), "Gōdo" (岐阜県安八郡神戸町), and "Kando" (鳥取県鳥取市).
* For [[kambemura]] locations, refer to [[Kobe Village (disambiguation)|Kobe Village (曖昧さ回避)]].
* For station names, see [[:en:Kobe Station (disambiguation)|Kobe Station (曖昧さ回避)]].

=== Sports Teams ===
* [[Vissel Kobe]] - A professional soccer team in the [[:en:J-League|J-League]].
* [[Deuçon Kobe]] - A professional futsal team in the [[F-League]].
* [[INAC Kobe Leonessa]] - A women's professional soccer team in the [[Nadeshiko League]].
* [[Kobe 9 Cruise]] - A professional baseball team in the [[Kansai Independent League (2009-2010)]].
* [[Kobe Suns]] - A successor baseball team in the Kansai Independent League (2011–2012).
* [[Elecom Kobe Finies]] - A professional [[American football]] team in the [[:en:X-League|X-League]].

== People and Other Uses ==
* [[Kōbe Clan]] - A powerful family in Ise Province. [[Oda Nobutaka]], son of [[Oda Nobunaga]], also adopted the name Kōbe.

=== Japanese Companies and Brands (with "Kobe" in the name) ===
* [[Kobe Bussan]] - A supermarket chain headquartered in [[Inami Town]], [[Kakogun]], Hyōgo Prefecture.
* [[Kobeya Bakery]] - A bread manufacturer based in [[Higashiyodogawa Ward]], Osaka. Also operates restaurants.
* [[Kobe Motomachi Doria]] - A restaurant chain under the [[Saint Marc Holdings]] group.
* [[Kobe Lamptei]] - A former fast-food chain specializing in gyūdon. Closed in 2017.
* [[Kobe Steel]].
* [[Kobe Bijin Nuka Honpo]] - A cosmetics company in Kobe, known for rice bran cosmetics.
